modality_provenance.quote: Oldest availlable chest X-ray (enlarged view) from 1986 showing no pathologic changes.
Chest X-ray from 1988 (enlarged view) showing a cystic lesion in the right lung measuring 3.2 cm (arrows).

Recent chest X-ray from October 2000(enlarged view)in p.a. projection showing the cyst measuring now 7 cm in diameter. In the upper third of the lesion a band-like structure is seen which was later identified to be an intracystic vessel (arrows)
Lateral projection (10/2000, enlarged view) showing the cyst located in the apical lower lobe but failing to show the intracystic vessel.
